OPeNDAP index ranges for a bounding box and date range on the PCIC grid

Source: R/wet_pcic_index.R
wet_pcic_index.Rd

The PCIC VIC-GL grid is 0.0625 degrees, with cell centres at lon0 + 0.0625 * i and lat0 + 0.0625 * j (both ascending). Time is daily, days since 1945-01-01, standard calendar, so the time index of a date is its day offset from the origin.

Usage

wet_pcic_index(
  bbox,
  start,
  end,
  origin = "1945-01-01",
  lon0 = -139.96875,
  lat0 = 41.09375,
  res = 0.0625,
  nlon = 496L,
  nlat = 367L
)

Arguments

bbox

Numeric c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in longitude/latitude.

start, end

Dates (or strings coercible by as.Date()), inclusive.

origin

Time origin of the dataset.

lon0, lat0

Centre of the first cell.

res

Cell size in degrees.

nlon, nlat

Grid dimensions.

Value

Named list of zero-based inclusive integer pairs: time, lat, lon.

Details

A cell is included when any part of it intersects bbox.

Examples

# 1981-2010, the slice fwapg uses: time indices 13149 to 24105
wet_pcic_index(c(-122.5, 54, -122, 54.5), "1981-01-01", "2010-12-31")
#> $time
#> [1] 13149 24105
#> 
#> $lat
#> [1] 207 215
#> 
#> $lon
#> [1] 280 288
#>
